components.description: One term of modified duties without a reduction in salary for a faculty member who gives birth or becomes a parent of a newborn or adopted child under six and carries at least half the care; at minimum relief from direct teaching. Birth mothers may take a second term on request.
components.faculty_group_note: Professors, Associate Professors, and Assistant Professors (SPG 201.93 'Applies to'); handbook 6.D.2: 'professorial faculty members'
